title: marattia microphylla
intro: Marattia microphylla, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of plant in the family Marattiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include being used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Marattia microphylla include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its various health benefits.
